label: Approved by
definition: The source record has been approved by the authority recorded in the target review record (reviewType APPROVAL).

label: Assessed by
definition: The control is assessed, for one claim type in one scope, by the target control assessment.

label: Challenges
definition: The source contradicts or undermines the target claim (defeater). Alias: DISPUTES.

label: Closed by
definition: The source is closed by the target closure evidence, reassessment result or review.

label: Composed of
definition: Whole-part structure: the source contains the target as a constituent. Acyclic.

label: Connects to
definition: The source is an endpoint of the target interface. Physical or logical connection only; implies no dependency, causality or reachability.

label: Constrains
definition: The source imposes a ceiling, condition, limitation or band withholding on the target. Attribute constraintType: CEILING, CONDITION, LIMITATION, BAND_WITHHELD, GATE_EFFECT.

label: Consumes resource
definition: The source draws on the target constrained resource (power, cooling, water, fuel, space, accelerator capacity).

label: Controlled by
definition: The target control system or actor can command the source's state or setpoints.

label: Depends on
definition: The source relies on the target to perform its function; each edge references exactly one Dependency record carrying type, strength and states.

label: Evaluates gate
definition: Control to CriticalGate: registry gate mapping, mandatory attribute gateRole (CRITICAL or SUPPORTING). ControlAssessment to GateResult: the result is an input to that gate evaluation. GateResult to CriticalGate: the result evaluates that gate.

label: Evidenced by
definition: The source is offered the target evidence. Records that evidence was presented, not that it is sufficient.

label: Exposed to
definition: The source is credibly susceptible to the target threat, hazard or failure mode.

label: Governed by
definition: The source is subject to the requirements, method or disclosure rule of the target.

label: Has evidence requirement
definition: The control or gate requires the target evidence requirement for a stated claim type.

label: Has finding
definition: The source result or gate evaluation records the target finding.

label: Has outcome
definition: The capability instance is required to achieve the target service outcome.

label: Has unknown
definition: The source has a material undetermined fact recorded by the target UNKNOWN record.

label: Implemented by
definition: The function, or the safeguard, is realised by the target architecture element.

label: Initiates
definition: The threat, hazard or failure mode is the initiating source of the target scenario.

label: Integration handoff
definition: The source AIDCF record is exchanged with the AI Trust Graph through the target reviewed handoff record (AIDCF-005).

label: Invalidated by
definition: The source can no longer be relied on because of the target event (evidence expiry, configuration drift, incident, test failure).

label: Located in
definition: The source is physically or logically placed in the target location.

label: Migrated from
definition: The source was produced from the target (prior version, legacy vocabulary or legacy record) by the migration recorded in migrationRef.

label: Monitored by
definition: The target observes the source and is relied on to detect its condition.

label: Operated by
definition: The target party holds operational responsibility for the source.

label: Propagates to
definition: Within a named scenario, failure of the source causes failure or degradation of the target; carries scenarioRef and step ordinal.

label: Protected by
definition: The target safeguard acts to prevent, detect, contain, correct or recover from failure of, or harm to, the source.

label: Qualifies
definition: The source limits the scope, states or conditions under which the target claim holds, without contradicting it.

label: Recommends
definition: The recommendation proposes the decision state and conditions taken up (or departed from, with reasons) by the target decision.

label: Recovers through
definition: The source is restored to tolerance by means of the target recovery path, alternate capacity or recovery safeguard.

label: Reported in
definition: The source is disclosed in the target report.

label: Requires action
definition: The source requires the target action to be completed (remediation, evidence collection, decision condition).

label: Requires function
definition: Achieving the outcome requires the target function to be delivered.

label: Results in
definition: Execution of the procedure, sample or test produced (contributes to) the target control assessment.

label: Reviewed by
definition: The source record has been reviewed in the target review record.

label: Shares fault domain with
definition: Source and target are members of the same FaultDomain and can fail together from its common cause. Symmetric; each edge references the FaultDomain record.

label: Summarised by
definition: The source results are aggregated into the target score snapshot or recommendation.

label: Supersedes
definition: The source replaces the target record of the same class; the target is retained with status SUPERSEDED. Acyclic.

label: Supports
definition: After review, the source evidence corroborates the target claim.

label: Triggers reassessment
definition: The source event or trigger rule requires reassessment of the target.
